lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Skill consolidation: slope as rate of change

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (10, -5) and (13, -17).

A line passes through these points:
x: -15, -13, -11
y: -11, -14, -17
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (-5, -10). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 4 and a vertical leg (rise) of 1. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 2 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
A line has a slope of 4. A right triangle drawn along the line has a vertical leg (rise) of 25 units. What is the length of the other leg?
Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope 3/2 and y-intercept 6.
Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = 8x + 3.

Relationship A (proportional):
x: 5, 10, 15
y: 12, 24, 36
Relationship B: y = 12x
By how much does the greater rate of change exceed the lesser rate of change?
For the line y = (9/2)x - 12, find y when x = -6.
A line has equation y = (-6/5)x + 20. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = x + 10. Write the equation of the line through (4, -4) that is parallel to this line.

The amount of water in a tank is given by G = 22t + 13, where G is the number of gallons in the tank and t is the number of minutes since filling started. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The tank fills at a rate of 13 gallons per minute.
The tank fills at a rate of 22 gallons per minute.
The tank already had 22 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank already had 13 gallons of water before filling started.

items.prompt: A taxi fare is given by F = 3m + 12, where F is the total fare in dollars and m is the number of miles traveled. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The fare increases by $3 for each additional mile traveled.
There is a base fare of $3 before any miles are traveled.
There is a base fare of $12 before any miles are traveled.
The fare increases by $12 for each additional mile traveled.
